note: GH-002 acceptance items as cases; statuses follow the plan's vocabulary (pass/fail/blocked/skipped/not-run). Evidence refs are files in this directory.

cases.expected: idle steady window over an empty home, complete process tree, OS memory basis
cases.actual: idle-empty gh 122.3 MiB / dsh 133.8 MiB PSS p50 over 60 one-second ticks, single-process tree

cases.expected: 1,000-session index fixture shared byte-identically by both sets
cases.actual: 1,000 sessions, 22 distinct bodies, 635,126 events, 859,513,879 logical bytes; sessions roots are per-entry symlinks into one corpus home

cases.expected: adoption of the ~11.6k-event session measured to process exit with an explicit model failure
cases.actual: bench-00990 (anchor 17, 11,620 events) adopted by both products; gh peak 133.7 MiB / dsh 150.8 MiB at 100ms ticks; exits: NO_ADAPTER (gh, 1) / MISSING_CREDENTIAL (dsh, 1); first attempt exposed the cwd-mismatch refusal, fixed by rewriting the adopt file's header frame to the set workspace

cases.expected: 100 boot cycles for start stability, labeled as not leak evidence
cases.actual: 100 cycles each; boot ms p50/p95/max gh 905/1005/1006, dsh 1004/1105/1106; steady tree PSS at +2s p50/p95/max gh 183.0/191.8/203.1 MiB, dsh 194.2/200.2/201.7 MiB (corpus home, still inside the boot transient)

cases.expected: all GH-managed processes sampled; PSS primary, RSS/private/swap alongside
cases.actual: tree walked by ppid each tick; steady trees are single node processes; per-pid rows in memory.csv, per-pid maxima in processes.json

cases.expected: the measuring driver's own cost is reported next to the numbers
cases.actual: driver CPU per measured window recorded in every idle result note: ~0.25-0.6s user+sys per 60s window

cases.expected: a second run over the same fixture explains itself against the first
cases.actual: idle PSS p50 deltas between run-main and run-full: gh empty 119.4→122.3, gh corpus 141.6→141.6, dsh empty 133.9→133.8, dsh corpus 148.7→155.0 MiB; same transient shape; adopt differs only in sampling resolution (1s→100ms)

cases.expected: ZCode pinned-revision memory baseline for the plan's GH/ZCode comparison
cases.actual: blocked: build requires Node >= 24, host has v22.23.2 with no Node 24 toolchain; unblock step recorded in run.json

cases.expected: heap/external, cache/lease/handle counts split out per §6.3
cases.actual: out of scope for this OS-level runner; requires the in-process resource-sampling provider, tracked as follow-up work before any MEM verdict
